The task is: Asymmetrically quantize to unsigned integers using a representable range that includes zero. Return q, scale, integer zero point, and reconstruction; support 1 through 16 bits.
The inputs are `x`, `bits`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
